{{Quote|There's a story that Dr. Nuvo Vindi gassed every agency on Ord Marsax the day after the Republic upped the bounty on his head to 250,000 credits.|Arack Dostryt, the ''Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook''|<ref name="BHC" />}}
'''Ord Marsax''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Belderone sector/Legends|Belderone sector]]. During the [[Pius Dea Era]], it served as a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|outpost]]. [[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] later, according to a story relayed by [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] member [[Arack Dostryt]], the researcher [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]] carried out [[Gas/Legends|gas]] attacks on every [[Posting Agency|bounty posting agency]] on Ord Marsax.

==Description==
Ord Marsax was a terrestrial<ref name="BHC" /> [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|419|Ord}} states that the term "[[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]]" and the abbreviation "Ord" applied to certain [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].</ref> located in the [[Ord Marsax system/Legends|Ord Marsax system]], a part of the [[Belderone sector/Legends|Belderone sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TransHydian" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
[[File:NuvoVindi2-SWE.png|thumb|right|275px|It was claimed that Doctor Nuvo Vindi attacked bounty posting agencies on Ord Marsax.]]
Ord Marsax served as an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] [[Colonist/Legends|outpost]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Pius Dea Era]], a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] that lasted between approximately [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] and [[11,000 BBY]]. Ord Marsax was situated outside the borders of the Republic and, when the Republic launched the [[Crusade of the Wilds]] against various [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] in [[11,791 BBY]], [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces]] advanced from Ord Marsax into neighboring areas of [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="EGTW" />

In a section of an edition of the ''[[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]]'' published<ref name="BHC" /> at some point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'' includes an [[in-universe]] copy of the ''[[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]]''. The included edition of the Handbook was published at some point following the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and is annotated by [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]], whose [[Death/Legends|death]] is depicted in {{Film|IV}}. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the formation of the Empire and the events of ''A New Hope'' in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], respectively, the included edition of the Bounty Hunters' Guild Handbook must have therefore been published at some point between those two dates.</ref> [[Arack Dostryt]], the [[Director of Recruiting]] for the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]], noted an account regarding [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]],<ref name="BHC" /> a researcher active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The story claimed that, after the Republic had increased the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Vindi to 250,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], he carried out [[Gas/Legends|gas]] attacks on every [[Posting Agency|bounty posting agency]] on Ord Marsax.<ref name="BHC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ord Marsax was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' later placed the Ord Marsax [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the world itself, in grid square R-6.<ref name="EAOC" />
